newsitem.title: BULGARIA: YIELD RISES TO 3.8 PCT ON BULGARIA 4-WK T-BILLS.
newsitem.headline: YIELD RISES TO 3.8 PCT ON BULGARIA 4-WK T-BILLS.

text.p: Yield rose further on Bulgaria's
Finance Ministry four-week discount T-bills at the daily
auction on Wednesday as the issue was undersubscribed, central
bank figures show.
The average yield to maturity on the issue was 3.80
percent, up from 3.78 percent at Tuesday's auction, 3.76
percent on Monday and 3.77 percent on Friday.
Rising yield on four-week paper this week could signal a
rise in the central bank main interest rate, set at 43.08
percent annually since Monday, a Finance ministry official
said.
"If yield does not fall sharply at the auction on Thursday
a (main interest) rate rise could be expected," the official
who declined to be identified told Reuters.
The central bank adjusts its main interest rate weekly to
the weighted average effective annual yield of four-week
discount T-bills auctioned daily from Friday through Thursday.
Details of the issue follow. Prices in percent of par:
Issue number BG3036597006
Maturity four weeks
Par value 26,000 mln levs
Issue date May 29
Maturity date June 26
Bids received 22,217.8 mln levs
Avg price of bids 96.34 pct
Bids approved 22,217.8 mln levs
Avg accepted price 96.34 pct
Avg yield to maturity 3.80 pct
